name: OSH Park
verify_note: Capabilities change. Verify on the fab's capability page before ordering.

processes.label: Two Layer Prototype, 1 oz, 1.6 mm, ENIG, purple mask ($5/in^2 for 3 copies)
notes: Copper: 'Trace width 6mil (0.1524mm)', 'Trace spacing 6mil (0.1524mm)', 1 oz, two layers, FR4, 63 mil (1.6 mm) nominal. (two-layer)

Drill: 'Minimum drill size 10mil (0.254mm)'; 'Minimum annular ring 5mil (0.127mm)'; max drilled hole 260 mil (6.604 mm), larger holes are milled; drills under the minimum 'will be increased to the minimum for that service'; plating 1 mil; size/position tolerance +/-2.5 mil max. PTH and NPTH are not given separate minimums. (two-layer, drill-specs)
Hole to hole: '5 mil (0.127mm) clearance is recommended between holes'; overlapping drills 'Allowed, but not guaranteed'. (two-layer)
min_via_diameter_mm 0.508 (20 mil), copper-to-hole 5 mil and hole-to-hole 5 mil are the values OSH Park tells you to enter in KiCad Board Setup for the 2-layer service. (kicad-design-rules)
Board edge: '15mil (0.381) from nominal board edge' (page omits the unit; 15 mil = 0.381 mm). (two-layer)

Silkscreen: '5 mil (0.127mm) (recommended minimum)', '3 mil (0.0762mm) (short lines, text, graphics)'; no minimum text height is published ('Silkscreen minimum text height' is left to user preference on the KiCad page). (two-layer, kicad-design-rules)
Soldermask: SMOBC both sides, purple; 'Minimum soldermask web: 4 mil (0.1016mm)'; 'Maximum soldermask alignment: 3mil (0.0762mm)'. No expansion value published. (two-layer)

Slots: native drill slots 'Slot widths 20mil (0.508mm) or wider', fully inside the board, not crossing other drills or the board edge; plated slots need an annular ring and copper beneath; non-plated slots must not cut copper. Cutouts on the outline must exceed 0.068 in (1.7272 mm) - the standard mill bit; smaller 0.04 in bits are 'not guaranteed'. (slots, board-outline)
Size: 'Minimum 0.25in (6.35mm) by 0.25in (6.35mm)'; 'Maximum 16in (406.4mm) by 22in (558.8mm)'. (two-layer)

Castellation: 'Allowed, but not guaranteed'. 'While we don't offer full support for castellations ... they can be fabricated if you don't mind a few minutes of rework'; use round pads for copper and mask, pads 'must also not extend more than 40 mil from the board edge', expect to file off support tabs and excess plating. (two-layer, castellation)
Impedance: no value or service is published for 2-layer -> null. (two-layer)

Pricing/turnaround: '$5 per square inch, which includes three copies of your design'; orders in multiples of 3; 'ship within 9-12 calendar days'. Other 2-layer services on docs.oshpark.com/services: Super Swift ($10/in^2, 4-5 business days), 2oz 0.8mm ($5/in^2), After Dark (black substrate, clear mask, $5/in^2), Medium Run ($1/in^2, 100 in^2 min, multiples of 10). (two-layer, services)

processes.label: Four Layer Prototype, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, FR408HR, 1.6 mm, ENIG ($10/in^2 for 3 copies)

stackups.name: OSH Park 4-layer FR408HR
stackups.notes: Top to bottom: silkscreen 0.6 mil, solder resist 0.6 mil, 1 oz Cu (1.7 mil, clad + plated), prepreg FR408HR 2113 7.87 mil (0.1999 mm), 0.5 oz Cu (0.68 mil), core FR408HR 39 mil (0.9906 mm), 0.5 oz Cu, prepreg FR408HR 2113 7.87 mil, 1 oz Cu, solder resist, silkscreen. Dk 3.61 at 1 GHz for prepreg and core. The page changelog mentions a temporary alternate stackup for some orders; confirm with OSH Park for impedance-critical designs.

notes: Copper: 'Trace width 5mil (0.127mm)', 'Trace spacing 5mil (0.127mm)', '1oz outer', '1/2oz inner'. (four-layer)
Drill: 'Minimum drill size 10mil (0.254mm)'; 'Annular ring 4mil (0.1016mm)'. (four-layer, drill-specs)

KiCad Board Setup values from OSH Park for 4-layer: clearance 5 mil, track 5 mil, annular ring 4 mil, via diameter 18 mil (0.4572 mm), through hole 10 mil, copper-to-hole 5 mil, hole-to-hole 5 mil, silk text thickness 5 mil. (kicad-design-rules)
Impedance: the page refers to an 'Impedance Constraint Table' image but publishes no numeric tolerance or service guarantee -> null. (four-layer)

Pricing/turnaround: '$10 per square inch, which includes three copies of your design'; 'ship within 9-14 calendar days'. Super Swift 4-layer $20/in^2 (5-6 business days); Medium Run $2/in^2 (100 in^2 min). (four-layer, services)

processes.label: Six Layer Prototype, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, FR408HR, 1.6 mm, ENIG ($15/in^2 for 3 copies)

stackups.name: OSH Park 6-layer FR408HR
stackups.notes: Symmetric: 1 oz outer Cu (1.7 mil); prepreg FR408HR 106 75% 4.36 mil (0.1107 mm, Dk 3.23); 0.5 oz Cu; core FR408HR 2113 4 mil (0.1016 mm, Dk 3.66); 0.5 oz Cu; centre core FR408HR 36.44 mil (0.9256 mm); mirrored below. Substrate ISOLA FR408-HR, 175 Tg. Mask Taiyo PSR-4000BN purple.

notes: 'Trace Width: 5mil (0.127mm)', 'Trace Spacing: 5mil (0.127mm)', 'Minimum Drill Size: 8mil (0.2032mm)', 'Minimum Annular Ring: 4mil (0.1016mm)', 'Board Edge Keepout: 15mil (0.381)'. (six-layer)

min_hole_to_copper_mm 0.254 is 'Plated drill to internal copper clearance: 10 mil (0.254 mm)' - an inner-layer figure. No KiCad Board Setup table is published for 6-layer, so via diameter and hole-to-hole are null. (six-layer)
'$15 per square inch, which includes three copies of your design'; 'Orders will ship within 12-21 calendar days' (changelog 15-DEC-2025: turn time changed from 9-14 to 12-21 days). (six-layer)
docs.oshpark.com/services lists fabrication services only (two-, four-, six-layer, flex, Super Swift, After Dark, Medium Run); no assembly or stencil service is described. (services)

Stencils: OSH Park's checkout can forward your paste layers to the partner OSH Stencils ('Ordering from OSH Stencils', blog 2020-06-18); include paste layers (F.Paste/B.Paste) in the upload if you want that option. (blog)

file_requirements.drill_format: Excellon, inches, 2:4 precision, zero suppression None or Leading
notes: Native KiCad: 'We accept .kicad_pcb board layout files directly'; uploads are processed with the latest stable KiCad (9.x at retrieval); docs apply to KiCad 7+. (design-tools/kicad)

Zone fills: 'Due to KiCad's file format, we do not re-fill zones for uploaded .kicad_pcb files' - the .kicad_pro design rules are not uploaded, so fill all zones (press B) and save before uploading. (design-tools/kicad)

Fonts: custom/OS fonts are not embedded in KiCad 7/8 board files and will be substituted; in KiCad 9+ enable Board Setup > Board Data > Embedded Files > Embed Fonts, or upload Gerbers instead. (design-tools/kicad)

Gerbers from KiCad are accepted and 'the filenames are detected automatically'. Recognised extension pattern (not case sensitive): .GKO outline, .XLN drills, .GTO/.GBO silk, .GTS/.GBS mask, .GTL/.GBL copper, .G2L/.G3L inner layers (rename unusual inner-plane names such as GP1/G1 to G2L/G3L). (design-tools/kicad, naming-pattern)
Drill file: 'We require the drills to be indicated using the Excellon Drill format', units inches, format 2:4, zero suppression None or Leading, absolute origin. (drill-specs)

Board outline: a closed, small but nonzero-width line; cutouts must fit a 0.068 in (1.7272 mm) end mill and must not touch the outline or have copper beneath; circular cutouts under 250 mil should be drawn as non-plated holes instead. Native drill slots (KiCad oval holes) are supported at >= 20 mil width and must appear in the drill file. (board-outline, slots)
Design rules: OSH Park publishes KiCad Board Setup values but no downloadable .kicad_dru; the DRU files in this kit encode those numbers. (kicad-design-rules)
